title: Les questions de Nadia
summary: Nadia calls a fictional training centre, clarifies an application step and checks the detail that remains uncertain.

sentences.fr: Nadia avait trouvé une formation qui correspondait à son expérience, mais la page d'inscription restait vague.
sentences.en: Nadia had found a program that matched her experience, but the registration page was still vague.

sentences.fr: Elle a appelé le centre pour savoir si une entrevue était obligatoire avant le dépôt du dossier.
sentences.en: She called the centre to ask whether an interview was required before submitting the application.

sentences.fr: La conseillère lui a expliqué que l'entrevue servait à vérifier les objectifs et les besoins de chaque personne.
sentences.en: The adviser explained that the interview was used to discuss each person's goals and needs.

sentences.fr: Nadia a ensuite demandé quels documents elle devait apporter et si une copie numérique suffisait.
sentences.en: Nadia then asked which documents she should bring and whether a digital copy was enough.

sentences.fr: La réponse était claire pour les relevés, mais la conseillère devait vérifier la règle sur les attestations étrangères.
sentences.en: The answer was clear for transcripts, but the adviser needed to check the rule for foreign certificates.

sentences.fr: Nadia a demandé qu'on lui confirme cette dernière information par courriel.
sentences.en: Nadia asked for that final piece of information to be confirmed by email.

sentences.fr: Avant de raccrocher, elle a résumé les étapes et vérifié la date limite de la demande.
sentences.en: Before hanging up, she summarized the steps and checked the application deadline.
sentences.note: When an answer is uncertain, ask for a written confirmation and repeat the next steps before ending the call.

quiz.prompt: Why did Nadia call the training centre?
options: She needed to change her work schedule
The registration page did not clearly explain the process
The centre had lost her application
She wanted to cancel a finished course
quiz.explain: The first sentence says the registration page was vague.

quiz.prompt: What point still needed to be checked?
quiz.explain: The adviser still had to verify the rule for foreign certificates.

quiz.prompt: How did Nadia make sure she understood the next steps?
options: She sent the same form twice
She asked another applicant to decide
She summarized them and checked the deadline
She ended the call before hearing the answer
quiz.explain: The final sentence gives both actions.
